note: Every spoken line in the game. 'text' is spoken and shown as a caption. 'cue' says what the child sees at the same time. {name} is replaced with the player's first name or nickname. To record a line, save it as public/voices/rich/<id>.mp3 and add the id to public/voices/packs.json.

lines.text: Hello! Let's get you ready for match day.
lines.cue: Your player appears in our blue and yellow kit.

lines.text: Tap a colour for your player's skin.
lines.cue: A row of skin colour circles glows.

lines.text: Now tap a hair style.
lines.cue: A row of hair styles glows.

lines.text: And tap a hair colour.
lines.cue: A row of hair colour circles glows.

lines.text: Looking great, {name}! Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Hi {name}! Tap the glowing chapter to play.
lines.cue: The next chapter to play glows.

lines.text: Play chapter one first. Then chapter two opens.
lines.cue: Chapter one glows.

lines.text: You've played both chapters! You can play them again any time.
lines.cue: Two footballs are shown.

lines.text: Peep!
lines.cue: A whistle sound. Not spoken.

lines.text: It's match day! We're the blue and yellow team.
lines.cue: Our five players stand at the side of the pitch.

lines.text: We're shooting this way, up the pitch.
lines.cue: A big arrow points at their goal.

lines.text: We have the centre kick. The ball sits on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball bounces onto the centre mark.

lines.text: The dotted ring is a helper. Real pitches don't have one. It shows five yards from the ball. That's about five big grown-up steps.
lines.cue: The dotted ring around the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where our team stands for our centre kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Tap a player, then tap where she should stand.
lines.cue: A finger taps a player, then a spot.

lines.text: When everyone is on her spot, tap the tick.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Put all five players on the pitch first.
lines.cue: The players still at the side bounce.

lines.text: The rule says: everyone starts in our own half.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us starts on the ball, on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay five yards away from the ball until it's kicked. Keep outside the dotted ring.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: Our team does: one player on the ball to take the kick.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: Our team does: a friend either side of the ball, level with it, so there are two easy passes.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Our team does: one player stays back, between our goal and halfway, a bit nearer our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Our team does: a keeper in our goal.
lines.cue: Our goal glows.

lines.text: Our team does: our front player waits just behind the ring, in the middle, ready to chase.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Our team does: a friend either side, a little further back than our front player.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Have another go.
lines.cue: The tick button comes back.

lines.text: Look for the glowing spots. That's where our team stands.
lines.cue: Glowing circles show the empty spots.

lines.text: Let's do one together. Watch.
lines.cue: One player walks to a glowing spot.

lines.text: Now you try the rest.
lines.cue: The glowing spots stay on.

lines.text: Everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: You kept trying, and now everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: The ref blows the whistle. Where should the first pass go? Tap where the ball should go.
lines.cue: The two friends, the far end and their goal all glow.

lines.text: Short pass to a friend. Good thinking!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend.

lines.text: Our team does: short pass to a friend. A long kick gives the ball away.
lines.cue: The ball flies long and the orange team gets it.

lines.text: The rule says: you can't score straight from a centre kick. Try a short pass to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball flies at their goal and a big cross appears.

lines.text: Look for the glowing friends. Tap one of them for a short pass.
lines.cue: Only the two friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: She takes the ball forward.
lines.cue: Our player runs up the pitch with the ball.

lines.text: Pass across to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball goes across to the other friend.

lines.text: Goal! We were ready, so we could pass and score.
lines.cue: The ball hits the net. Our players jump.

lines.text: You've earned a football for chapter one. Well played, {name}!
lines.cue: A football flies into your collection.

lines.text: Later in the match, the other team has a centre kick.
lines.cue: The orange team lines up.

lines.text: They're in orange. Their kicker is on the ball.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand when they have the centre kick? Put our five players in our defending shape.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They kick off.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend.

lines.text: Our front player closes down straight away.
lines.cue: Our front player runs at the ball.

lines.text: We stay together and defend as a team.
lines.cue: Our players move across together.

lines.text: Their shot goes wide, out over our goal line.
lines.cue: The ball rolls past our goal and off the pitch.

lines.text: That means it's our goal kick! We'll find out what to do in the next chapter.
lines.cue: Our keeper picks up the ball.

lines.text: You've earned a football for chapter two. Brilliant defending, {name}!
lines.cue: A football flies into your collection.
